generation.scope: At a simple finite mark with full middle supports and common triple of cross-bracket rank two, the two commutators admit an invertible pencil member. A Sylvester equation reconstructs the common triple in terms of the pencil and three scalar parameters, subject to cyclicity and a trace condition.

open_mathematics: Analyze pairs of four-dimensional marked spans, the remaining one-sided-symmetry cases, and branching and non-simple finite windows.
